about.title: About me
description: Graduated from EPITA, a French engineering school in Paris, I dove into Computer Science through my studies and internships.
With a strong interest in web development — particularly design and user experience — I chose to build my career as a Front-End Engineer.
After graduating in 2017, I moved to the United States and joined Heartflow in the Bay Area — a medical software company that helps doctors diagnose coronary artery disease.
I've since relocated to Austin, where I continue to work for Heartflow.

events.job: Front-End engineer working on Heartflow’s medical platforms and tools to diagnose coronary artery disease.
Freelance Front-End engineer focused on developing the new Innso Knowledge Base application.
Graduated with a Master’s Degree in Computer Science, specializing in Web and Mobile Development.
Internship focused on building a new mobile app from scratch for tracking live event schedules for poker players attending Winamax Tournaments.
Internship centered around full-stack development, implementing new tools and features for Clubvivre's customer and internal platforms.

skills.title: My skills
description: I enjoy building hand-crafted websites with a personal aesthetic touch, and I've developed a strong eye for translating web and mobile designs into structured, standards-compliant HTML / CSS without compromising cross-browser support.

Comfortable with modern web technologies, I gravitate toward well-supported, innovative client libraries like Vue.js — currently my favorite. That said, I firmly believe mastering the fundamentals of Vanilla JS is what truly elevates an app's performance and user experience.
I also have experience with server-side technologies like Node.js, and practical knowledge of tools such as Docker and web servers like Nginx.
Always chasing new challenges, I keep myself updated with the latest trends and developments across the World Wide Web.
